name: claude-context-bar
description: Real-time context window usage monitor for Claude Code sessions. See token counts in your status bar with color-coded warnings.

claudeContextBar.autoColor.description: Automatically assign different colors to each project (rainbow). When off, uses your base color with subtle variations.

claudeContextBar.baseColor.description: Base color when Auto Color is off. Each project gets a subtle variation of this color.

claudeContextBar.showEmoji.description: Show emoji icons based on project name (music 🎵, code 💻, game 🎮, etc.)

claudeContextBar.contextLimit.description: Fallback context window size in tokens, used only for unknown or non-Claude model IDs. Current Claude models are auto-detected (1M by default, 200K for Haiku and legacy models).

claudeContextBar.modelContextLimits.description: Per-model context limit overrides (Model ID → token limit). Exact match only, no glob or prefix matching. Example: {"claude-haiku-4-5": 500000}. Highest priority: overrides auto-detection and the fallback for that exact model.

claudeContextBar.warningThreshold.description: Percentage at which to show warning color (yellow)

claudeContextBar.dangerThreshold.description: Percentage at which to show danger color (red)

claudeContextBar.showUsage.description: Show your Claude subscription usage (the 5-hour session limit from /usage) as a separate item to the right of the context items. Opt-in: reads the Claude Code OAuth token and calls an undocumented Anthropic endpoint, which may stop working at any time. Requires being signed in to Claude Code with a subscription.

claudeContextBar.usageWarningThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which to show warning color (yellow) on the usage item

claudeContextBar.usageDangerThreshold.description: Usage percentage at which to show danger color (red) on the usage item

claudeContextBar.usageRefreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh subscription usage from the /usage endpoint. The endpoint rate-limits aggressive polling, so avoid very low values.

claudeContextBar.idleTimeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before hiding a session (default: 180 / 3 minutes). Set 0 to never hide idle sessions. Click to manually hide.

claudeContextBar.configDir.description: Claude Code config directory — the folder that contains projects/, not projects/ itself. Leave empty to use the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, then ~/.claude. Set this if VS Code does not inherit your shell environment (common when launched from the Start Menu or Finder).

claudeContextBar.compactMode.description: Shorten project names to save status bar space. Multi-word names become acronyms (my-cool-project → MCP), single words become abbreviated (typescript → Tscript). Names ≤5 chars stay unchanged.

claudeContextBar.shortNames.description: Custom short names for projects. Keys are project names, values are the short versions (e.g. {"my-cool-project": "MCP", "webapp": "WA"}).

enumDescriptions: Show the Claude Code session title (from /rename or the generated summary)
claudeContextBar.label.description: What to show as the status bar name. Hover always includes the session title when Claude Code has written one.

enumDescriptions: Show usage as a percent of the model context window
Show usage as an absolute token count (e.g. 185K)
claudeContextBar.usageFormat.description: How to show context usage on the status bar. Warning and danger colors still use percent of the model window.
